title: 菜单选择、厨房交接、分账与结账
scope: Synthetic dine-in case; tax, service charges, tips, FX, offline card authorization and cross-business-day reopen excluded. Kitchen tickets, checks and tender attempts remain independent; no production Toast/Stripe integration.

transitions.guard: 菜单版本、modifier 数量及价格合法
保留原 revision 与授权原因

transitions.recovery: 厨房响应决定是否停止原制作

transitions.guard: ticket revision 唯一且内容完整
当前 revision 未取消
制作证据
数量与选择匹配
经理权限与原因
当前状态核对
transitions.durable_effect: 保存待决请求与先前制作阶段

transitions.guard: 确认未继续制作及报损处置
transitions.recovery: 旧 accepted 回执不能重启

transitions.guard: 已制作证据和责任人
transitions.durable_effect: 免单/继续/报损决策引用

transitions.trigger: 经理决定继续或记录成品
transitions.guard: 明确处置授权
无已启动付款，子责任与金额守恒
transitions.durable_effect: 原账单只读并关联新 checks
transitions.recovery: 并发 version 冲突重预览

transitions.guard: 冻结本次账单版本
确认付款合计=应付且无未决占额
制作例外已有解释且例内结账条件满足
原子检查可发起余额并占额
transitions.durable_effect: 保存 attempt 和未决金额

transitions.guard: 无明确成功或拒绝
金额币种账户与 attempt 匹配
transitions.recovery: 重复通知读取已有成功

transitions.guard: 权威无成功副作用证据
原交易可确认
明确拒绝且无成功副作用
现金与卡交易、退款明细均匹配
有差异及责任人
有批准的解释与证据

checks.when: send once, prepare, serve, split responsibility equally for side, pay each check
checks.then: checks3887/3512; total7399; one shared-side kitchen task; close after confirmations
checks.evidence_required: menu snapshot, tickets, check shares, payment evidence, UI states

checks.when: worker resends same outbox after restart
checks.then: one KDS task; paper reprint marked duplicate and requires human confirmation
checks.evidence_required: ticket uniqueness, KDS count or print confirmation record

checks.when: deliver old accepted or pending notifications
checks.then: cancelled/current payment facts retained; no restart or reopening based on stale event
checks.evidence_required: event order, current object read, UI state

checks.given: check7399, cash3000 confirmed, two cashiers attempt4399
checks.then: only one pending attempt; other explicit conflict; no overcollection

checks.given: two restaurants have table12 and check number100
checks.when: read/menu cache/command with another restaurant reference
checks.then: no data disclosure or foreign kitchen/payment side effect
checks.evidence_required: scope mapping, cache hit/miss responses, ticket and payment records

checks.given: card attempt4399 accepted externally but response lost; cash3000 applied
checks.when: cashier attempts another4399 then queries original
checks.then: new tender blocked; unknown4399 visible; confirmation closes7399 once
checks.evidence_required: attempt IDs, balance equation, terminal lookup, visible feedback

checks.given: selection, ticket and outbox committed before worker crashes
checks.then: same selection revision and one ticket; UI finds original operation
checks.evidence_required: database rows, replay trace, KDS receipt

checks.given: selection quantity3 with no-sauce modifier quantity1
checks.then: reject mismatch; corrected selections1 and2 produce total3 portions
checks.evidence_required: validation message, saved selections, kitchen configurations

checks.when: allocate remainder and split already-sent check
checks.then: discount263/238; dues3887/3512; no second shared-side ticket
checks.evidence_required: integer arithmetic, shares sum, original ticket IDs

checks.when: manager requests cancel and cook reports too_late
checks.then: original production preserved; approved comp/serve/waste separately recorded
checks.evidence_required: ticket stage, manager reason, amendment and money records

checks.when: receive explicit decline, or merely another timeout
checks.then: decline releases4399; timeout keeps reserved4399; no false paid
checks.evidence_required: authoritative result, reservation ledger, collectable UI

checks.then: cash application3000; confirmed total7399; drawer movement3000
checks.evidence_required: cash entries, change, card transaction, shift comparison

checks.given: payment attempt already submitted on parent check
checks.when: try split check without payment allocation model
checks.then: reject with unresolved payment explanation; no orphaned tender
checks.evidence_required: version guard, original check/tender links and UI
